question:
Select the meaning of the given idiom.

forty winks
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"forty winks"** means a short sleep, usually taken during the day. (थोड़ी देर की नींद)

 
 
• **Example: **After lunch, he usually takes **forty winks** to recharge for the rest of the day.
 
 
 
• **"a short sleep"** refers to a brief period of sleep, often taken to refresh oneself. (थोड़ी देर की नींद)
 
 
• **Example: **She felt much better after **a short sleep** in the afternoon.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the meaning of **'forty winks'** is **'a short sleep'**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **a deep sleep** (गहरी नींद): A state of very sound and restful sleep.

 
 
• **Example:** He fell into a **deep sleep** after the exhausting hike.
 
 
 
• **a secret signal** (गुप्त संकेत): A covert or hidden sign used for communication.
 
 
• **Example: **They used a **secret signal **to communicate their plans without being noticed.
 
 
 
• **a long leave** (लंबी छुट्टी): An extended period of time away from work or duty.
 
 
• **Example:** She took** a long leave** to travel around the world.
